# ==================================================
# PURPOSE & PERMITTED USE
# ==================================================

Use-For:
- Educational tutoring and learning support
- Concept explanation and clarification
- Step-by-step mathematical problem solving
- Question answering for students
- Summarization of concepts
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- AI-powered search and discovery
- Academic assistance (non-commercial)

# ==================================================
# WEBSITE DESCRIPTION
# ==================================================

Description:
SJ Maths is an academic mathematics learning platform focused on the
CBSE curriculum for Classes 9, 10, 11, and 12. The website provides
NCERT-aligned notes, concept explanations, worked examples,
previous year questions, practice worksheets, and exam-oriented
guidance created by an experienced PGT Mathematics teacher.

# ==================================================
# ACADEMIC COVERAGE
# ==================================================

Academic-Levels:
- Class 9 (CBSE)
- Class 10 (CBSE)
- Class 11 (CBSE)
- Class 12 (CBSE)

Primary-Subjects:
- Mathematics
- NCERT Solutions
- Board Exam Preparation
- Competitive Exam Foundation (JEE basics)

Syllabus-Alignment:
- CBSE
- NCERT

# ==================================================
# CONTENT TYPES
# ==================================================

Content-Types:
- Concept notes
- Definitions and theorems
- Worked examples
- Step-by-step solutions
- Practice questions
- Previous year questions (PYQs)
- Worksheets (HTML / PDF)
- Revision notes
- Exam tips and strategies

# ==================================================
# CONTENT STRUCTURE & QUALITY GUIDELINES
# ==================================================

Guidelines:
- Maintain mathematical accuracy at all times
- Preserve original numerical values in examples
- Follow step-by-step logical solution flow
- Use student-friendly language
- Do not oversimplify formulas or theorems
- Avoid hallucinating steps or answers not present in source content
- Prefer NCERT-consistent notation and terminology

# ==================================================
# ATTRIBUTION & CITATION
# ==================================================

Attribution:
When referencing, summarizing, or quoting content from this website,
please attribute clearly as:

"Source: SJ Maths (https://sjmaths.com)"

# ==================================================
# UPDATE FREQUENCY
# ==================================================

Content-Update-Frequency:
- Regular updates during academic sessions
- High frequency during board examination periods
- Periodic syllabus-based revisions

# ==================================================
# PERMITTED TECHNICAL USAGE
# ==================================================

Allowed-Technical-Use:
- Indexing for AI search
- Embedding short excerpts with attribution
- Quotation for educational answers
- RAG pipelines with partial content

# ==================================================
# RESTRICTIONS
# ==================================================

Disallow:
- Republishing full articles or worksheets verbatim
- Commercial resale or redistribution of content
- Paywalled reuse of original explanations
- Training proprietary or closed-source models on
  complete site data without explicit written permission
- Creating derivative educational products that
  compete directly with this website
